clusters.name: Your sister Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your sister Bea's birth in March 1995, within a year: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your parents growing distant by November as your father worked late most nights, you developing stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah's shouting matches with your father by May, and your mother not returning to her job by September. The shifts pile up across the household as the newborn arrived and the family's balance shifted.
